In 38 boss maps (The Crucible (Necrohol of Nabudis), Cloister of Solace (Necrohol of Nabudis), Cloister of Reason (Necrohol of Nabudis), Heaven's Challenge (Pharos - Third Ascent), Withering Shores (Nam-Yensa Sandsea), Grand Bower (The Salikawood), Gate of Water (Giruvegan), Gate of Fire (Giruvegan), Gate of Wind (Giruvegan), Crystal Peak (The Great Crystal), Dhebon Jilaam Avaa (The Great Crystal), Dell of the Dreamer (Golmore Jungle), Southern Sluiceway (Garamsythe Waterway), No. 1 Cloaca (Garamsythe Waterway), Ore Separation (Henne Mines), Special Charter Dig (Henne Mines), Tasche Span (Lhusu Mines), Site 7 (Lhusu Mines), Redolent Glade (The Feywood), Terminus No. 7 (Barheim Passage), Empyrean Seat (Mosphoran Highwaste), Ward of Steel (Stilshrine of Miriam), Hall of Worth (Stilshrine of Miriam), Throne of Veiled Gods (Stilshrine of Miriam), Dunes of Profaning Wind (Pharos - First Ascent), Marsh of Profaning Wind (Pharos - First Ascent), Penumbra - North (Pharos - Subterra), Cleft of Profaning Wind (Pharos - Second Ascent), Hall of Shadowlight (Sochen Cave Palace), Hall of Lambent Darkness (Sochen Cave Palace), Hall of the Wroth God (Sochen Cave Palace), They Who Thirst Not (Pharos - First Ascent), Colosseum (Ridorana Cataract), Valley of the Dead (The Tomb of Raithwall), Hall of the Destroyer (The Tomb of Raithwall), Hall of the Sentinel (The Tomb of Raithwall), Wyrm's Nest (Dalmasca Westersand), Athroza Quicksands (Zertinan Caverns)), once the script has removed the boss and the other foes (bosskillall, zakokillall), it reads and plays the victory pose while scratch 0x16 is 0: 47 sites, for example bds_e01 lines 365, 370 and 372. Every field transition zeroes scratch1 (../Scripts-And-Script-Commands/script-variables.md), and the only stores to scratch 0x16 in the us scripts are stores of 1 by 38 scene scripts, each after the scene's skip section ends (skipend): in 31 of them on the branch taken when that section was skipped (skipcheck, verb 0x51C, returns whether it was skipped; for example bds_f0101 lines 382 and 428), and in the other seven on a branch of a test that compares the skip check with a file variable of the scene (bds_e0101, dgl_h0101, gil_h0101, grm_f0101, hne_e0101, lus_e0102 and mic_d0101). No map script stores to it, so a store of 1 holds until the next field transition. In Central Brig Access (Dreadnought Leviathan), after the battle with the lesser judges, while the story counter is at least 930 (After the Leviathan tutorial) and below 966 (After the battle with the lesser judges): the script removes the foes, gives control to the first fighting member when a guest or an Esper leads (verb 0x3083), and plays the pose with no scratch test (rsn_d01 lines 239, 246, 251, 257 and 259). In Trial Mode, on clearing Stage 100: the director of each of the 100 stage scripts tests the field, and on any other stage it ends with a map jump instead (tri_a01 lines 1717 and 2301); on Stage 100 (tri_t05, field 1311) it removes the foes, gives control as above, plays the pose and takes the party to field 1147 (ttl_d01) (tri_t05 lines 1712, 2315, 2320, 2330, 2332 and 2341).
